instruction: Compare sizes of compression algorithms on the same data
output: tar cf /tmp/test.tar ./testdata/ && for algo in gzip bzip2 xz zstd; do time "$algo" -c /tmp/test.tar > /tmp/test.tar."$algo" && ls -lh /tmp/test.tar."$algo"; done
